features.title: Shared character motion
features.summary: Player and Warden share motion requests, momentum resolution and motor collision handling.
features.note: The motor alone moves the collision body; player fall reactions remain separate from Warden behavior.

features.title: Shared action lifecycle
features.summary: Actions share commitment, timing, one buffered follow-up, interruption and cleanup.
features.note: Accepted actions capture their definitions and pay validated costs when starting.

features.title: Health, stamina and mana
features.summary: Per-character resources handle damage, healing, atomic spending and delayed regeneration.
features.note: Stamina regeneration depends on movement state; flasks use inventory-backed charges.

features.title: Item catalog and inventory
features.summary: Shared definitions support owned copies, stacks, charges, movesets and versioned records.
features.note: Existing sword, two spells and flask use the system. Loot acquisition and a full inventory UI are deferred.

features.title: Equipment and quick slots
features.summary: Hand assignments and spell/gadget slots coordinate held, stowed and released equipment.
features.note: Bow/shield fixtures demonstrate two-handed stowing; bow attacks, blocking, bashing and dual wielding are deferred.

features.title: Authored item upgrades
features.summary: Individual items apply authored damage/healing multipliers by upgrade level.
features.note: Test Grounds exposes sample +1/+2 upgrades. Upgrade currency, crafting and adventure progression are deferred.

features.title: Animation and appearance system
features.summary: Physics-owned poses, reusable rig profiles and item animation banks keep visuals aligned with gameplay.
features.note: UAL is the temporary player model; some actions retain adapters. Final art and replacement animations require review.

features.title: Fitted damage sensing
features.summary: Seventeen animated body regions confirm projectile, melee and area contacts on both player appearances.
features.note: Regions take equal damage. Combat reads the prior physics snapshot; the Warden retains its existing receiver path.

features.title: Shoulder camera and target lock
features.summary: Configurable shoulder view, camera collision and target locking support third-person control.
features.note: Camera preferences persist; targeting and locomotion facing have separate owners.

features.title: Menus and saved settings
features.summary: Shared menus provide camera, remappable controls, display settings and staged Apply/Discard behavior.
features.note: Navigation restores focus and remembers the last settings tab; PS1 effects can be toggled.

features.title: Test Grounds and diagnostics
features.summary: Eight lab stations, practice combat, item testing and optional diagnostics exercise the shared player.
features.note: Fixtures for future abilities do not implement those abilities. Resets rebuild the starter loadout.

features.title: Soulbound HUD and mana evolution
features.summary: An editable browser preview demonstrates the reviewed health artwork, Soul reserves and six mana stages.
features.note: Godot integration, 12-HP balance, kill rewards and gameplay reserves are not implemented.

features.title: Performance and character scaling
features.summary: Contact caching, shared validation and prepared combat assets are implemented and release-benchmarked on Iris Xe.
features.note: Five actors meet matrix p95 targets but spikes remain; ten exceed fitted-motion/combat budgets. Native profiling and full-encounter validation remain.

features.title: Seeded seamless world generation
features.summary: A finite procedural world and seamless dungeons use reproducible seeds, guaranteed landmarks and placement rules.
features.note: The roadmap proposes a 256 × 256 m pilot with 64 m regions; these are test dimensions.

features.title: World streaming
features.summary: Off-thread generation, asynchronous resource loading and budgeted activation support regional traversal.
features.note: Loading-order determinism, safe connectivity and measured boundary costs belong to the generation pilot.

features.title: Saves, checkpoints and currency recovery
features.summary: Serialization contracts exist; gameplay saves, checkpoint respawning and recoverable progression currency are planned.
features.note: Item records round-trip with validation. Disk saves, persistent world changes and safe-load placement are not implemented.

features.title: Structural collapse
features.summary: Connected prebuilt pieces lose support, become physical groups and persist significant destruction.
features.note: Start with one small structure and measured body/collapse limits; terrain remains intact.

features.title: Adventure content and progression
features.summary: Quest lines, encounters, loot and broader progression follow the movement and world pilots.
features.note: Freeform builds and equipment-weight effects are future direction; detailed gameplay rules remain deferred.

features.title: Walking, running and sprinting
features.summary: Camera-relative travel uses momentum, reversal braking, slope adaptation and steps up to 0.60 m.
features.note: Gait cadence and planted contacts follow movement; target-facing lateral/backward travel still uses forward clips.

checklist.text: Existing acceleration/stopping, diagonal/S-turn speed, full-reversal braking and independent lock-on body rotation stay passing

features.title: Adaptive forward dive
features.summary: Forward/no-direction dodge selects a clearance-aware dive with retained travel until contact.
features.note: Gap and platform crossings are validated; the old dodge hop was removed.

features.title: Side and backward rolls
features.summary: Directional rolls start grounded with 0.70 s playback and retain departure speed when leaving an edge.
features.note: Rolls retain the authored reach, stamina cost and immunity window without a physical hop.

features.title: Jumping
features.summary: A fixed 1.2 m jump costs 15 stamina and supports edge grace, input buffering and limited air steering.
features.note: Compatible attacks and spells remain usable in the air; momentum survives action completion.

features.title: Falling and landing damage
features.summary: Impact speed determines soft, damaging and lethal landings using equivalent-height thresholds.
features.note: Dodge immunity does not prevent fall damage; deep-water entry follows swimming rules.

features.title: Timed landing roll
features.summary: A fresh dodge in the final 0.15 s can spend 25 stamina for a roll and halve eligible nonlethal fall damage.
features.note: Lethal heights never receive the discount; failed heavy cliff dives enter ragdoll.

features.title: Ragdoll and automatic get-up
features.summary: Descending hits and lethal landings activate physical ragdoll; survivors recover after settling and clearance checks.
features.note: Supported get-up uses face-up/down variants; water and blocked-standing crawl recovery have validated fallbacks.

features.title: Ledge grab, hang and pull-up
features.summary: Eligible static lips support persistent hanging, clearance-tested pull-ups and deliberate release.
features.note: Hanging neither drains nor regenerates stamina; pull-up costs 10. Supported landing-height variation is bounded.

features.title: Sideways hanging and corners
features.summary: Left/right input moves along validated ledges and rounds inside/outside corners independently of camera orbit.
features.note: Blocked or unsupported routes retain the last safe hold; this is not free wall climbing.

features.title: Crouching and low passages
features.summary: Persistent crouch supports 2 m/s travel, low tunnels and clearance-checked standing transitions.
features.note: Forward-downhill knee correction is implemented; gait-entry snaps, backward knees and diagonal contact/skin defects remain deferred.

features.title: Hands-and-knees crawling
features.summary: Hold crouch for 0.5 s to enter a persistent 1 m/s crawl through the supported 0.90 m passage.
features.note: Implemented on the UAL player despite older deferred notes. Unsupported animation profiles reject entry; combat and traversal actions are disabled.

checklist.text: hold C → crawl → cross the 0.90 m lane → stop → reverse through it → attempt to rise under the roof → exit → tap to crouch → tap to stand.
Repeat on both shoulders, then enter the swimming pool and verify breath and restoration.

features.title: Surface swimming and water exits
features.summary: Water entry transitions to floating/swimming, stamina-funded fast strokes and automatic validated ledge exits.
features.note: Test Grounds station 05 is playable; deep-water entry cancels incompatible actions and landing damage.

checklist.text: WASD swims relative to the camera. At the surface movement stays level; underwater it follows camera pitch as well as yaw.
Swim toward a safe ledge to grab and pull up. Once attached, the existing hang, sideways movement, forward pull-up, and dodge-to-release controls apply.

features.title: Underwater diving and swimming
features.summary: Camera pitch/yaw steer underwater travel; crouch descends, jump ascends and released input holds depth.
features.note: Underwater combat, currents and moving/wavy water remain deferred; low-roof posture transitions are collision checked.

checklist.text: Releasing movement holds depth after a short deceleration.

features.title: Head-based breath and drowning
features.summary: Mouth/nose immersion consumes 20 seconds of breath, then applies drowning damage through shared health handling.
features.note: Breathing follows the completed head pose during crouch, crawl, ledge and ragdoll states; camera tint is independent.

features.title: Light combos and heavy attacks
features.summary: Sword attacks use committed timing, stamina costs, hit confirmation and one queued follow-up.
features.note: Light attacks use native UAL2 A/B clips and recoveries. Tap for light; hold for the interruptible UAL1 Sword_Attack heavy windup.

features.title: Azure Bolt and Violet Burst
features.summary: Equipped spells deliver a projectile or area burst with mana costs, windup and recovery.
features.note: Both allow grounded/airborne casting. Crawling and swimming disallow spells; accepted casts retain their selected-item values.

features.title: Flask and healing gadgets
features.summary: Healing actions consume inventory-backed flask charges or the selected gadget's authored supply policy.
features.note: Stackable potion and reusable charm are testing fixtures; retry/station reset restores starter equipment.

features.title: Warden encounter and retries
features.summary: The courtyard boss uses telegraphed combo, overhead and lunge patterns with death/victory and retry flow.
features.note: The Warden shares action/motion foundations while retaining its own controller and legacy Knight presentation.

features.title: Sliding
features.summary: A future slide mechanic will define entry speed, slope response, braking and exits.
features.note: Controls, animation references and acceptance criteria remain to be agreed before implementation.

features.title: Free wall climbing
features.summary: Future climbing includes vertical/lateral wall travel, attachment, corners, release and ledge exits.
features.note: Existing ledge hanging and water exits provide only part of the traversal foundation.

features.title: Boss climbing
features.summary: Shadow of the Colossus-inspired climbing on an articulated giant: marked surfaces, inverted traversal, leaps, resting, bracing and charged weak-point stabs.
features.note: Planning and technical design are in progress; gameplay implementation and acceptance testing are pending. The full Ultra-agent plan records agreed controls, shared stamina, moving-surface ownership, collision safety, presentation, development gates and validation.

checklist.text: Moving attachments follow translation, rotation and articulation, with at most 2 cm drift over 30 seconds and inherited release velocity applied once.
Traverse marked curves, animated joints and fully inverted undersides; leap and regrab, with unmarked or blocked routes stopping safely.
Validate carry, rotation, posture, initial overlap and standing against world geometry and other boss limbs without penetration or unsafe capsule expansion.
Keep planted hands within 3 cm of accepted contacts, preserve shoulder continuity and bone lengths, and sample hitboxes and mouth-based breath from completed poses.
Verify shared stamina, supported recovery, bracing, charged weak-point stabs and single damage application at 30/60/120 Hz, within 0.5 stamina across equivalent runs.
Verify remapped controls, grip toggle, both shoulder cameras, independent render rates, pause, reset, teleport, death, unload, falling, water entry and two independent characters.
Complete the hands-on route: approach → grab moving leg → cross joint → hang upside down → leap/regrab → rest → brace → charge/stab → release/land.
Pass focused tests, the full regression runner, clean release/export and smoke checks; record profiling and update movement documentation and the context graph.

features.title: Push, carry and throw
features.summary: Future object handling covers weight, contact, pickup, held state, aiming, release and impact.
features.note: Laboratory fixtures do not implement these interactions.

features.title: Powered flight
features.summary: Permanently unlocked flight will share spell mana and provide takeoff, hover, steering and landing.
features.note: Mana exhaustion must switch to ordinary falling in the same tick; flight is not currently playable.
